roles.title: Knowledge Management Analyst
roles.description: Analyze enterprise knowledge repositories, SOPs and operational documentation across business and technology teams, improving accuracy, consistency and access to reliable guidance.
highlights: Reviewed 120+ knowledge assets to identify outdated information, duplicate content and process gaps across business and technology teams.
Gathered requirements from subject matter experts and process owners to structure information through standardized taxonomies, metadata, naming conventions and content ownership guidelines.
Supported repository consolidation by mapping legacy documentation to standardized structures and identifying duplicate or obsolete materials across 3 knowledge repositories.
Developed and maintained SOPs, knowledge articles, FAQs and process guides, coordinating reviews with content owners.
Tracked content freshness, review compliance and documentation gaps through governance reports, helping stakeholders prioritize overdue reviews.

roles.title: Business Systems Analyst
roles.description: Business systems analysis for application enhancements, covering requirements, API and data-flow analysis, and UAT with developers, QA and business stakeholders.
highlights: Elicited requirements through stakeholder interviews and process workshops, translating them into functional specifications, user stories, use cases and acceptance criteria.
Documented BRDs, FRDs, business rules and process flows, comparing AS-IS and TO-BE workflows to find gaps and dependencies across 4 key business workflows.
Analyzed REST API interfaces and integration requirements, documenting field-level mappings and validation rules for 3 system interfaces.
Used SQL and Excel to validate application data, reconcile reporting discrepancies and investigate business-rule exceptions.
Coordinated with developers, QA engineers and product teams across 8 Agile sprints, and prepared UAT scenarios and test cases to support defect resolution before release.

roles.title: Business Analyst
roles.description: Business analysis for application enhancements: requirements, workflow and gap analysis, reporting definitions and UAT support.
highlights: Gathered requirements through stakeholder interviews, workshops and existing-system reviews, translating them into functional requirements for development and testing teams.
Created BRDs, FRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria and process flows supporting 5+ application enhancements.
Mapped AS-IS and TO-BE workflows and ran gap and impact analysis to find process inefficiencies and recommend improvements.
Queried and validated business data with SQL and Excel, reconciling discrepancies across 10+ reporting datasets.
Defined reporting requirements, KPIs and validation criteria, and supported UAT by validating acceptance criteria and tracking defects, with traceability in Jira and Confluence.
